summary: Before PRs to Ansible-maintained collections, run ansible-test sanity and tox -elinters from the collection root after installing requirements.txt; tox runs black (check mode) and flake8 with preset options.
questions: What checks must pass before I submit a network collection PR?
How do I install linters for a network collection?

answer_card.title: Run sanity and linters before a PR
answer_card.answer_md:
CI fails if these fail, so run from the collection root:
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
ansible-test sanity
tox -elinters
```
`tox -elinters` reads `tox.ini`, installs tools like `black` and `flake8`, runs them with preset options, and runs `black` in check mode (shows files that would be reformatted).
